title: Read docs from the test output copy everywhere
lead: S12-9 reads schema and descriptor.md from the test output copy, but ConsumerSubsetTests, NullSpellingsOtherDistinctTests and NullSpellingLimitsTests still read docs through `CallerFilePath` (source tree), so two mechanisms exist and a packed or PathMap test run would break the latter. Copy `design.md` too and move those tests to the shared loader.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Failing test: those tests run with the source tree absent; 2. move them to the test-output loader; 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
